paper_metadata.title: A Low-Power 20-GHz 52-dB Transimpedance Amplifier in 80-nm CMOS
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper describes the design of a transimpedance COMPARISON OF HIGH-SPEED TRANSIMPEDANCE AMPLIFIERS amplifier (TIA) for a low-power, short-distance, high-density fiberoptic interconnect communication system. The single-ended circuit has been designed in an 80-nm digital CMOS process and consumes only 2.2 mW from a 1-V supply. The measured results show a transimpedance gain of 52 dB and a large bandwidth of 20 GHz. This work presents the highest bandwidth at the lowest power consumption for CMOS transimpedance amplifiers reported to date.
